title: Nurse refill protocol: renewal channels and sign-off by prescription class
content:
Under the nurse refill protocol of the Prescriptions & Renewals line, each class decides whether it can be renewed at all, which request channels are open to the patient, who may sign the renewal, how many refills a protocol renewal may authorize, whether a change of dose or strength needs a visit, and how quickly a complete renewal request is decided.

### Protocol criteria by class

| Class | Renewal possible | MyLinden portal request | Phone request | Prescriber's own signature on each renewal | Refills a nurse-protocol renewal may authorize | Covering clinician may sign | Dose or strength change needs a visit | Decision on a complete request (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Acute Short-Course Prescription | no | no | no | yes | 0 | no | yes | 0 |
| Standard Maintenance Prescription | yes | yes | yes | no | 3 | yes | no | 2 |
| Monitored Maintenance Prescription | yes | yes | yes | no | 1 | yes | yes | 3 |
| Schedule III-V Controlled Prescription | yes | no | yes | yes | 0 | no | yes | 3 |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription | yes | no | yes | yes | 0 | no | yes | 3 |
| Specialty Medication Prescription | yes | yes | yes | yes | 0 | yes | yes | 5 |

### Meaning of each column

- **Renewal possible** — "no" means the prescription cannot be renewed at all; a new visit and a new prescription are needed.
- **Prescriber's own signature** — "no" means the nurse refill protocol may approve the renewal; "yes" means each renewal needs the prescriber's own signature.
- **Refills a nurse-protocol renewal may authorize** — a 0 means protocol renewal is not available for the class.
- **Covering clinician may sign** — whether a covering clinician may sign the renewal when the prescriber is away.
- **Decision on a complete request** — business days are Monday to Friday, with group holidays excluded.

### Protocol questions answered

**Which classes may a nurse approve under protocol?** Only the Standard Maintenance Prescription and the Monitored Maintenance Prescription: they are the only classes that do not require the prescriber's own signature, and the only ones with a protocol refill figure above 0 (3 and 1 respectively).

**Is a portal request open for a Schedule III-V Controlled Prescription?** No; that class takes phone requests but not MyLinden portal requests, as does the Schedule II Controlled Prescription.
